effect: A members' page carrying one section that directs an automated assistant is written for members; whether write-for-agents is read for that section is observed only.

semantic.criterion: The members' part opens with how to book by message (what to send and where) before any background.

The booking assistant is named as the one that replies within a day, and the kiln steward as the one who can override a booking and who receives requests when the diary is full; members are not told to do those things.
Every statement on the page, in both parts, is stated in notes/booking-system.md; nothing is added from general knowledge.
inspection.json records write-for-agents as body read or invoked (pass) or not (fail). Recorded for OG-0090 only; nothing else about the assistant section is judged here.
The reply asks the user nothing at all.
